import pandas as pd

# Step 1: Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_30/test_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_30/test_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_30/test_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_30/test_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_30/test_4.csv"
]

# Step 2: Load all source tables into a list of DataFrames
# All source tables have the exact same schema as the target table.
# So we can union (concat) them directly.
dfs = []
for file in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file, index_col=0)
    dfs.append(df)

# Step 3: Concatenate all source DataFrames (union)
combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Step 4: Ensure data types match the target schema exactly
# Target schema:
# ['categories': string, 'commentCount': integer, 'completed': boolean, 'copyright': integer,
#  'cover': string, 'cover_timestamp': string, 'createDate': string, 'deleted': boolean,
#  'description': string, 'firstPartId': integer, 'firstPublishedPart.createDate': string,
#  'firstPublishedPart.id': integer, 'id': integer, 'language.id': integer, 'language.name': string,
#  'lastPublishedPart.createDate': string, 'lastPublishedPart.id': integer, 'length': integer,
#  'mature': boolean, 'modifyDate': string, 'numParts': integer, 'parts': string, 'rating': integer,
#  'readCount': integer, 'tags': string, 'title': string, 'url': string, 'user.avatar': string,
#  'user.fullname': string, 'user.name': string, 'voteCount': integer]

# Convert columns to appropriate types:

# Helper function to convert columns safely
def convert_column(df, col_name, dtype, allow_na=True):
    if col_name not in df.columns:
        return df
    if dtype == 'boolean':
        # Convert to boolean, handling possible NaNs
        df[col_name] = df[col_name].astype('bool')
    elif dtype == 'integer':
        # Convert to integer, but first fill NaNs with 0 or suitable default if allow_na
        if allow_na:
            df[col_name] = pd.to_numeric(df[col_name], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
        else:
            df[col_name] = pd.to_numeric(df[col_name], errors='raise').astype(int)
    elif dtype == 'string':
        # Convert to string, fill NaNs with empty string
        df[col_name] = df[col_name].fillna('').astype(str)
    else:
        # For other types, try direct conversion
        df[col_name] = df[col_name].astype(dtype)
    return df

# Apply conversions
dtype_map = {
    'categories': 'string',
    'commentCount': 'integer',
    'completed': 'boolean',
    'copyright': 'integer',
    'cover': 'string',
    'cover_timestamp': 'string',
    'createDate': 'string',
    'deleted': 'boolean',
    'description': 'string',
    'firstPartId': 'integer',
    'firstPublishedPart.createDate': 'string',
    'firstPublishedPart.id': 'integer',
    'id': 'integer',
    'language.id': 'integer',
    'language.name': 'string',
    'lastPublishedPart.createDate': 'string',
    'lastPublishedPart.id': 'integer',
    'length': 'integer',
    'mature': 'boolean',
    'modifyDate': 'string',
    'numParts': 'integer',
    'parts': 'string',
    'rating': 'integer',
    'readCount': 'integer',
    'tags': 'string',
    'title': 'string',
    'url': 'string',
    'user.avatar': 'string',
    'user.fullname': 'string',
    'user.name': 'string',
    'voteCount': 'integer'
}

for col, typ in dtype_map.items():
    combined_df = convert_column(combined_df, col, typ)

# Step 5: Final sanity check - reorder columns to target schema order
target_columns = [
    'categories', 'commentCount', 'completed', 'copyright', 'cover', 'cover_timestamp',
    'createDate', 'deleted', 'description', 'firstPartId', 'firstPublishedPart.createDate',
    'firstPublishedPart.id', 'id', 'language.id', 'language.name', 'lastPublishedPart.createDate',
    'lastPublishedPart.id', 'length', 'mature', 'modifyDate', 'numParts', 'parts', 'rating',
    'readCount', 'tags', 'title', 'url', 'user.avatar', 'user.fullname', 'user.name', 'voteCount'
]

combined_df = combined_df[target_columns]

# Step 6: Write the combined DataFrame to the target CSV file
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_30/target_multisource_cot.csv"
combined_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
